description: Add additive diagnostics to capture runtime evidence of format/stride mismatch at the NVENC encode boundary. ISS-014 corruption is classified as likely BGRx/XR24→NV12 interpretation mismatch. This slice instruments push_frame and the PipeWire capture path to log incoming fourcc, stride, and buffer dimensions so the eventual fix lands with captured evidence instead of inference.
title: ISS-014 encode-boundary format diagnostics instrumentation
